beats.text: Your assistants understand you with an {ai}AI model, running {pc}on your own PC. What you say {stays}doesn't have to leave it.
Let's {choose}choose a model, add {servers}other servers, and {gpu}share the graphics card.
It's all in {settings}Settings, Brain. The model {loads}loads by itself when you talk to an assistant. And on {auto}Automatic, it uses the {biggest}biggest one that fits in your graphics card.
Want another one? {add}Add model, paste a {hf}Hugging Face link or name, and the {fits}biggest that fits is already chosen. Keep {vision}vision ticked, so it can see images, and {download}download.
In {think}To think harder, pick the model it uses when you say {over}think it over, when the question is hard, or when it {wrong}gets something wrong.
Already running {ollama}Ollama, {swap}llama-swap or {lmstudio}LM Studio, on this PC or another? Add them in {other}Other servers, and {list}their models join the list.
And it tells you {where}where your words go: {thispc}this PC, {network}your network, or the {internet}internet.
When nobody talks to it, the model {unload}leaves memory after the time you choose. Next time, it {again}loads again in a few seconds.
And start a {game}game on the whole screen, and it {frees}frees the graphics card by itself. A {film}film doesn't count.
One last tip: before a render, free it {action}from a command, with the Assistant: brain action. Or simply tell your assistant: {say}free the brain.
